deck_outline.title: Cedar Ridge Trail Festival 2027
deck_outline.body: Two days of trail racing in Cedar Ridge, North Carolina, May 15 to 16, 2027: 50K, 25K, 10K and a kids' mile, run by a nonprofit that maintains the trails.

deck_outline.title: Who you reach
deck_outline.body: 1,240 runners (forecast) and 2,000 spectators (forecast) on site; 5,723 email recipients per send (mean of 6 campaigns), opening at 45.8%; 9,340 Facebook and 6,200 Instagram followers; 21,400 website users in 90 days.
footnotes: Attendance: from the user, forecast (registration cap 1,300; 2026 growth carried forward).
Instagram: from the user, not measured (Instagram not connected).

deck_outline.title: Who they are
deck_outline.body: 62.0% are 25 to 44 and 55.0% live in the Carolinas: hobby runners and hikers who replace shoes and gear every season.

deck_outline.title: Why it works for a running or outdoor brand
deck_outline.body: The people who buy trail shoes, gels and hydration packs are all in one place for two days, with their feet and their bottles in your hands at the aid stations and the finish village.

deck_outline.title: What each package includes
deck_outline.body: Presenting sponsor: festival name 'presented by', start and finish arch, bib logo, booth; emails 3, Facebook posts 4, Instagram posts 4; Summit booth: 10x10 booth in the finish village, logo on the finish-line banner; emails 2, Facebook posts 2, Instagram posts 2; Trail banner: course banner at a named mile marker; emails 1, Facebook posts 1, Instagram posts 0; Aid station: named aid station with signage and sampling; emails 0, Facebook posts 1, Instagram posts 0

deck_outline.title: Activation ideas
deck_outline.body: Presenting: shoe demo tent at packet pickup. Summit booth: gait checks or gel sampling. Trail banner: a mile-marker photo spot. Aid station: your product in runners' hands at mile 12.

deck_outline.title: 2026 sponsors
deck_outline.body: List Hollins Gap Outdoor Co., Larkmoor Physical Therapy, Fernhollow Coffee Roasters and Pinecrest Bike and Run only after each confirms in writing. No quotes unless the user has them in writing.

deck_outline.title: Timeline
deck_outline.body: Commitments by 2027-03-01 so logos make the bibs and shirts; event May 15 to 16, 2027; sponsor report within 14 days.

deck_outline.title: Next step
deck_outline.body: A 15-minute call to pick a package. Contact: the festival director (name and email to be added by the user).

proposal_letter.text: Each May, 1,240 trail runners (forecast) and about 2,000 spectators (forecast) come to Cedar Ridge for the Cedar Ridge Trail Festival 2027. 62.0% of our website visitors with a known age are 25 to 44, and 55.0% visit from the Carolinas (GA4, 2026-07-30 to 2026-10-27). Our emails go to 5,723 people per send (mean of 6 campaigns) and 45.8% open them (Klaviyo, same period). Packages run from $1,250 to $6,250, which works out at $280.32 to $360.75 per 1,000 impressions (attendees, email opens and post views, each send and post counted). Every sponsor gets a report within 14 days of the race showing what was delivered, measured. The money keeps 40 miles of trail open. Can we find 15 minutes to talk about the package that fits?

outreach_emails.body: Hi Tallgrade Footwear team, I saw your trail shoe ads, and your support of the Blue Hollow 50K. On May 15 to 16, 1,240 trail runners (forecast) race the Cedar Ridge Trail Festival 2027, and 55.0% of our website visitors are in the Carolinas (GA4, 2026-07-30 to 2026-10-27). Our Summit booth package delivers about 11,594 impressions and reaches up to 7,417 people (forecast attendance plus our email and social numbers for the same period).
